title: Solar Array Latch Jam
description: A deployable solar array failed to latch fully; deployable generation is reduced by half.
precedent: NASA Lucy (2021). One circular solar array did not fully latch; the mission continued.

title: Solar Energetic Particle Event / CME
description: A solar particle event threatens spacecraft electronics. Non-hardened computers face a 40% chance of burnout.
precedent: Galaxy 15 (2010). A commercial GEO satellite stopped responding to commands after a space-weather event.

title: Orbital Debris Conjunction Warning
description: A debris conjunction requires a decision.
precedent: ISS and Sentinel fleet. Routine debris-avoidance burns.

title: Monsoon Cloud Cover Blockade
description: Monsoon clouds block optical imaging for seven days. Radar can see through clouds.
precedent: Copernicus Emergency Management. Optical satellites are blinded by monsoon clouds; radar provides flood maps.

title: Apogee Engine Isp Underperformance
description: The engine delivered 10% less delta-v than planned.
precedent: Apollo 11 and Chandrayaan. Propellant reserve margins.

title: Mission Extension Approval
description: Mission extension approved: +20% of base Science Points.
precedent: Voyager, LRO and Opportunity. Missions extended far beyond their planned life.
